MoCHi

Your personal AI workspace. A single place to bring your models, memory, files and ideas together.

Explore MoCHi

Why MoCHi

Capability, with room to make it yours.

MoCHi is built around the idea that an AI workspace should adapt to the person using it. Work across leading AI models with your own provider keys, keep memory close, search when you need context, and shape a workspace that fits the way you think.

What it brings together

Provider choice

Use your own provider keys and choose the models that fit the task.

Memory & context

Keep important threads and context available as your work continues.

Search & files

Move between conversations, references and uploaded work without losing the thread.

Projects & workspace

Organize ongoing work in a space that can be customized around you.

Voice & images

Work with more expressive forms of interaction when text is not enough.

Charts & creation

Turn ideas and information into useful visual outputs when the moment calls for it.

MoCHi is the primary featured product from Toumiō Labs. Visit the live workspace to learn more and try it for yourself.
